title: Guangzhou Rains and Nobody Opens an Umbrella — The Qilou Arcades | China Travel Expert
description:
In Guangzhou it rains a lot — and locals barely reach for an umbrella. The reason is the qilou: covered arcade streets where the upper floors reach out over the sidewalk.

After Guangzhou began pulling down its old city walls in 1918, it built nearly 40km of these arcade streets within a decade — a blend of Paris-style arcades and Lingnan rain wisdom. Around 36 arcade stretches survive today, with some of the most intact along Enning Road (parts dating to 1931) in Liwan District.

🧭 Expert Tip: Walk Enning Road for the best-preserved qilou, then cut into the lanes around Shangxiajiu for old teahouses and snack shops.
